name: Datasur DC2 / Datasur: Suriname 2
notes: Operational Datasur data center at Van't Hogerhuysstraat 54-60, Paramaribo; Baxtel lists it as Datasur: Suriname 2 with 516 gross sq ft. Datasur says it was established by Telesur in 2014 as Suriname's first commercial Tier 3 designed / Tier 2 implemented datacenter.

name: Cloudflare Paramaribo edge data center
notes: Cloudflare announced Paramaribo as one of six new cities in its 2020 network expansion and stated that it had turned up a data center in Suriname; current Cloudflare network page lists Paramaribo, SR among data center locations.

name: Datasur DC1 / Datasur: Suriname 1
notes: Operational Datasur primary commercial colocation/cloud facility at Peprepinweg 96B, Wanica. Baxtel lists Datasur: Suriname 1 as Suriname's largest data center with 1 MW, 48,437 total sq ft and 6,975 gross sq ft; Datasur describes itself as the first and biggest commercial certified datacenter in Suriname.
